Three Times is Still a Charm at La Villa
Feb 2024 • Couples
Three Times is Still a Charm

After we booked our Southeast Asian cruise, we knew we wanted to go back to the La Villa French restaurant that we found in 2012. At that time the La Villa was a newer French restaurant located in a developing district of Ho Chi Minh City. Thierry and Tina are excellent hosts and are fully deserving of their accolades. The service you receive is second to none. You can read my first review of La Villa in Tripadvisor, dated 12/2/2012. On this occasion, we ordered the Set Menu #2. The food and presentation were excellent. We dined with another couple who never experienced La Villa but who were familiar with French cuisine having lived many years in Provence. They too were impressed. I highly recommend La Villa for travelers and residents alike. For cruisers, it’s a 20 min ride from Ben Thanh market but could be hard to find. Just use a metered taxi and follow your progress on a Maps navigation app. From Ben Thanh, it’s less than 300 baht and La Villa will call a taxi for you after your meal. One final note. We made our reservation many weeks out and La Villa asked for a deposit. That seemed reasonable since La Villa is a small restaurant with a limited number of tables.

Dear Mr. and Mrs. Kool,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback on Tripadvisor. We were disappointed to learn about your experience and sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused by our deposit policy.

We understand that our deposit requirement, while common for some restaurants, stems from our commitment to sustainability and a personalized dining experience. With only 11 tables and the limited ingredients, deposit allows our Chef to create each dish with the freshest ingredients possible and minimize waste. Since deposit will also be fully deducted to the bill upon dining, we hope this commitment to quality and reducing our environmental impact resonates with you.

We acknowledge that not all restaurants adopt this approach, and we completely understand your initial hesitation. We tried to reach you via email and WhatsApp to clarify the purpose of the deposit, but we apologize if these attempts were unsuccessful.

We would be truly disappointed if this single aspect of our policy deterred you from trying La Villa. We take immense pride in crafting unique culinary experiences tailored to each guest, and we're confident you'd enjoy the exquisite flavors and our warm hospitality.

We value your feedback and hope to welcome you soon to truly experience La Villa Restaurant.

Sincerely,

La Villa Team

World class gourmet cuisine !
Sep 2023 • Couples
This is an amazing dining experience. The location is a quiet street in district 2. The restaurant was previously a villa , hence the name. It is the epitome of fine dining. Exactly as you would expect, fresh white table cloths, sparkling cutlery and glasses. 
The staff are very friendly, attentive and helpful. But the reason to come here is the food. A taste of heaven in every morsel. On the evening we were there, there was a choice of 3 set menus or a la carte. We opted for one of the set menus which comprised several courses. There is an option to also add a wine pairing with each course. My wife doesn't drink so we did not try this. 
The food is simply amazing ! Beautifully presented and every mouthful is absolutely delicious. I have had the opportunity to eat in several gourmet restaurants in different parts of the world, La Villa is far and away the most delicious food I have ever eaten. 
Yes, it is a little more expensive than a typical restaurant but the entire experience of location, service, the food and meeting the chef at the end of the meal is more than worth the cost. If you are looking for the ultimate dining experience then you owe it to yourself to try this place. You will not be disappointed.

Have heard a lot about this restaurant and his chef/owner Thierry. Have to say that the experience was beyond expectations. The whole atmosphere was taken care of to the minimum details, the staff excellent, friendly and skilled. As for the food, few places in Vietnam can beat it, if any. Oysters are a must.
